name: @cas/ui
description: The suite's shared browser SHELL: an accessible-canvas mount, a fatal-error boundary, a worker-offload compute client, and the suite navigation header. Ports Complex Dynamics' proven product-shell patterns so every TS app gets them uniformly (ADR-0028). Consumed via SOURCE by the suite's Vite/Vitest bundlers (no dist build).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
